differences.what: A module, exam_cv_rhythm, that the General note type includes: its section Heart rate, rhythm and sounds shows only while Cardiovascular (exam.systems is cardiovascular) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal. Cardiovascular is two modules, one for each piece; exam_cv_perfusion is the other.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory section 7 (pieces 6 and 7), default 10

differences.what: Rate / Rhythm is two choose-one questions (Oct 19): Rate is Normal (added), Tachycardic or Bradycardic; Rhythm is Regular or Irregular. Normal fills Normal and Regular.
Heart sounds is choose-many. Normal S1/S2 is the normal option and is not exclusive: normal first and second sounds are charted with a murmur, rub or gallop beside them. Other asks for a short text.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 13, 26, 31 (a reading of default 13, as for Moist: Normal S1/S2 describes the first and second heart sounds, not every sound); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #23): the clinical team confirms which normal options are held beside a finding

differences.what: If Murmur Is Present: a group, Murmur, that shows only while Murmur is picked, holding Location, Character, Intensity and Radiation.
Location is choose-many. Other asks for a short text.

differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 14 (a three-way state list)

differences.what: Intensity is a whole number from 1 to 6, shown out of 6.
Radiation is choose-many. None is exclusive. Other asks for a short text.
